entities.summary: Charles Kong Djou is an American politician and attorney who served as secretary and chief executive of the American Battle Monuments Commission. A former member of the Republican Party, Djou briefly served as U.S. representative from Hawaii's 1st congressional district from May 2010 to January 2011. As of 2026, he is the last Republican to represent Hawaii in Congress.
